role: Request-time output filter for LLM assistant replies: rewrites any sentence matching a MedicalTermLexicon concept (diagnosis, referral, AFib, overtraining, cure, etc.) or an OffensiveTermLexicon slur/sexual term into a neutral localized deflection, and provides the sentence-segmentation helpers the streaming buffer uses to hold back incomplete sentences.
types: CoachVoiceGuard: enum — namespace for scrub rules, deflection copy, sentence splitting and the scrub/containsProhibitedLanguage API
CoachVoiceGuard.Rule: struct — a MedicalTermLexicon.Concept plus audit reason; deflection resolved at read time
CoachVoiceGuard.Result: struct — scrubbed text + triggers audit list + didIntercept flag

CoachVoiceGuard.SafetyCopyProgress: struct (Equatable, Sendable) — how far a reply has followed one of the canned safety replies (candidate replies as sentence keys + sentences matched), carried between the pieces of one reply
OffensiveTermLexicon: enum — English slur/explicit-term concepts (every-reply list and English-only list) and NLLanguageRecognizer-based reply-language gate
state: mem:CoachVoiceGuard.softTerminators (static let: \n ، — terminators that can fall inside a deflected phrase)
toplevel: Static lets are lazily initialised on first access: rules maps MedicalTermLexicon.scrubFromOutput to Rule(reason 'Coach output: <id>.') — one rule per scrubbed concept, and a concept without a specific deflection falls back to observationFallback (the comment on rules says so); medicalEntries/offensiveEntry/englishOnlyOffensiveEntry compile each rule via entry(for:), which logs an error naming any rule whose pattern fails to compile before compactMap drops it. everyReplyEntries = medical entries then the offensive entry. Callers: AssistantViewModel+Context.swift (stream flush, scrub(_:continuing:) with the round's progress), AssistantViewModel+Routing.swift (post-stream whole message), VoiceConversationController+Speech.swift (every spoken utterance, scrub(_:continuing:) with the chunker's progress), VoiceConversationController+Control.swift (interjection text).

units.does: Chooses the active rule set for a text: everyReplyEntries, plus the English-only offensive entry when that entry matches the text AND the reply is judged English (recognizer or app language).

Scrubs a whole reply that starts with no canned safety reply under way: returns the input unchanged if it is empty or no active rule matches anywhere (incl. emphasis-stripped); otherwise runs scrub(_:continuing:) with a fresh SafetyCopyProgress, so the app's canned safety copy passes only where it appears as the canned reply (opening sentence first, then its sentences in order). Called from AssistantViewModel+Routing.swift (post-stream pass), VoiceConversationController+Control.swift (interjection text) and tests.

branches.effect: true: return Result(scrubbed: output, triggers: []) unchanged; false: scrub(_:continuing:) from a fresh progress

units.does: A progress with no canned safety reply under way: no candidates, nothing matched.

Scrubs one piece of a reply, carrying `progress` from the pieces before it. Empty input returns unchanged without touching progress. Otherwise selects the active rules, builds the canned replies' sentence keys (safetyCopyReplies), and walks the sentence segments once: a segment whose key is non-empty and continuesSafetyCopy accepts (the opening sentence of a canned reply, or the next sentence of the one under way) is appended byte-identical after the run before it is scrubbed (scrubRun); every other segment, a whitespace-only one included, joins the current run, and any non-empty one that is not canned copy ends the canned reply under way. The last run is scrubbed too. Returns the rebuilt text with every run's triggers; progress is left where the piece ended. Runs on clean text as well, so callers that feed a reply in pieces send every piece.

branches.effect: return it unchanged, progress untouched
canned-copy sentence or part of the current run

branches.cond: key is empty (whitespace only) OR continuesSafetyCopy rejects it
branches.effect: true: added to the current run; false: the run so far is scrubbed (scrubRun), the segment is appended unchanged and a new run starts

Returns whether any candidate remains, i.e. the sentence is canned safety copy in its place.

branches.cond: no candidate continues with this key
branches.effect: true: candidates = replies opening with the key, matched = 1 (or 0 with none); false: candidates = the continuing ones, matched + 1

branches.cond: no reply opens with the key (?:)
branches.effect: matched = 0

branches.effect: return it unchanged with no triggers

units.does: Handles a match that spans a sentence boundary: logs an error, re-runs the matching regex on the original text, replaces all segments overlapping the match with one deflection, and returns that text (the other segments byte-identical, no tidy pass) if no rule matches it any more; otherwise (no raw match, e.g. matched only after emphasis stripping, no overlap, or residual match) returns just the deflection as the whole message with the full output as the trigger.

branches.cond: raw regex match found on original text AND its range converts AND replacing() returns non-nil AND rebuilt text has no remaining match
branches.effect: true: Result(rebuilt, trigger = matched substring); false: fail closed — Result(scrubbed: entire reply replaced by the rule's deflection, trigger = whole output)

units.does: Rebuilds the text from segments, keeping segments that do not overlap the matched range and emitting the deflection once in place of the first overlapping segment (later overlapping segments dropped); returns nil if no segment overlapped.
